reviews.reviewText:
Overall exam was quite on the numerical side rather than theory.
MCQs:
- Mostly from inventory topic (Debit/Credit).
- FIFO, LIFO, Weighted Average Method.
- Depreciation under Straight Line Method.
- Formula for closing stock.
Short Questions:
- Fill in Ledger account and Debtors account.
- Trade Debtors account.
- Cashflow statement (Identifying Cash In and Cash Out).
Long Questions:
- Partnership: Finding profit sharings (Net profit, partners ratio, salaries given).
- Make Fixed Asset Account with given data.

Paper kafi easy tha conceptual tha , accruals se ziada tha ledger accounts bnany thy, current asset ki value calculate krni thi, ak inventory k question tha ias 2 k according solve krna ha, 
Mcqs m ziada tr journal entry thi k rental income ha tw usko close krna k lia kis account ko debit kraingy
